items.title: Ralph Emerson Brown and Jasper Taylor Interview, 1961-05-23

ctx.x: Yeah. I'd start with xylophone. Was Freddie working with you at the theater? No. I, uh, cutting Freddie about, uh, we, uh, dear And so I came along with him and so I used to drink with him and so Freddie would always say, I'm going to make a record with you. And I told him about this number I had. And so he asked. He said, well the first chance I get is we'll make that number. And I think that I got the date to Inc. Williams. I told Freddie about it and Freddie got the band together. And we rehearsed it up and…
there. I'm not sure. And Jackson, Benjo, Charlie Jackson. Because he does the Salty Dog on
there. Oh yeah. I don't know whether, I couldn't say Jackson with Freddie. Freddie was from there. Jackson didn't even need music.
